{{Quote|Oh yeah, I've heard of Moff Darcc.|Han Solo|<ref name="SWGB" />}}
An ambitious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], '''Hindane Darcc''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Governor/Legends|governor]], and later [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] served under the command of Moff [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Executrix/Legends|''Executrix'']]. After his assignment aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], Darcc was transferred to the forest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. There, he rose through the ranks of Imperial rule, eventually becoming governor of the planet.

After [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], resulting in the Empire's subsequent disarray, Darcc used the vast Imperial resources at hand on Kashyyyk, as well as his position as planetary governor, to proclaim himself Moff of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Ruling from Kashyyyk inside his [[Darcc's Palace|Palace]], Darcc formed alliances with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Pekt]] and the traitorous Wookiee [[Weebacca]] in an effort to rid the planet Kashyyyk of its native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, the arboreal [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

Moff Darcc's rule over Kashyyyk worried Wookiee chieftain [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], who contacted his son, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], in an effort to petition the burgeoning [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Chewbacca, together with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], responded personally after the New Republic proved unable to assist. Once made aware of Darcc's intentions, Chewbacca formed an army, joining several Wookiee villages, in an effort to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberate]] the planet. Though Darcc tried to defeat the growing resistance, the Wookiees forced the Moff to flee the planet with Pekt and take refuge within a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] above Kashyyyk. Pursuing the Moff and bolstered by a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|collection]] of New Republic forces, Chewbacca's army overwhelmed the Imperial defenses, killing Darcc and destroying the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|station]].

==Biography==
===On the ''Executrix''===
By the termination of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Hindane Darcc was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He was assigned to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Executrix/Legends|''Executrix'']], where Darcc was responsible for meeting leading [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] figures at Tarkin's request, along with commanding troopers. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] was requested to meet with Moff Tarkin by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], stationed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], home of the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species. Darcc met the Dark Lord, and led him to the ship's captain.<ref name="DL:TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

===The Darcc times===
{{Quote|The Empire's definitely here all right.|Han Solo|<ref name="SWGB" />}}
[[File:DarccSubjugates.jpg|thumb|left|Darcc stands alert.]]
Eventually, Darcc was reassigned from captaining the ''Executrix'' to serve planetside on Kashyyyk. He rose through the ranks to become [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the planet. Once word of Emperor Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|demise]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], of which was stationed above the forest moon of the planet [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], along with a pivotal [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|victory]], Darcc claimed complete control of Kashyyyk. Due to his position of power, as well as control of the Imperial technology located on the planet, Darcc proclaimed himself Moff of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. The new Moff established a [[Darcc's Palace|Palace]] in his Imperial garrison, not far from the villages of [[Ittummi]] and [[Chenachochan]], in which he ruled the planet.<ref name="SWGB" />

However, his plans for Kashyyyk did not include the presence of the Wookiees. Forming a pact with [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Pekt]], Darcc instructed him and his hired Trandoshans to [[Devastation of Kashyyyk|remove]] entire villages of Wookiees. With Imperial assistance, the captured Wookiees would be transported off-planet, where they would either be sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] or killed, skinned, and sold for their pelts. Darcc also made an alliance with the Wookiee [[Weebacca]], who agreed to help Darcc and Pekt in selling Weebacca's fellow species. Weebacca was able to use his status as a Wookiee to trick others and allow Pekt's slavers easy captures.<ref name="SWGB" />

===Authority challenged===
{{Quote|No sign of Darcc. I'll wager that's him and Pekt in that transport.|Han Solo, upon sighting Darcc's shuttle leaving the planet|audio=NoSignOfDarcc.flac|<ref name="SWGB" />}}
[[File:DarccPektEscape1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darcc and Pekt escape Kashyyyk with a cargo hold full of Wookiees.]]
[[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], a chief of one of Kashyyyk's many Wookiee villages, became distressed at the increasing presence of Imperial troops, as well as the simultaneous disappearance of several Wookiee villages. Around 4 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> he called upon his son [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who was involved with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;a burgeoning government formed from the Rebel Alliance dedicated to fighting the remnants of the Empire&mdash;by association with New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Informed of the Wookiees' plight, Chewbacca attempted to bring the matter before the leading members of the New Republic. When they turned down his petition, the Wookiee left for Kashyyyk with Solo in tow, in order to find out the extent of the problem first-hand.<ref name="SWGB" />

Once they landed, Solo and Chewbacca encountered the first of Moff Darcc's Imperial troops as well as Pekt's Trandoshan slavers. They also spotted Weebacca, taking on an encampment on his own. At the command of Darcc, Weebacca infiltrated the party, assisting where he could, including defending against an attempt to halt the creation of the [[Government Tree]] by Darcc's and Pekt's individual forces. Weebacca fulfilled his mission when he led Chewbacca's forces into a trap engineered at [[Okikuti]], though the party managed to escape and ventured closer to Darcc's base. Darcc, meanwhile, continued his quest to remove the presence of the natives. Working together with [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], a retired Trandoshan [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Darcc managed to strike and capture another tribe of Wookiee villagers.<ref name="SWGB" />

After Chewbacca's army, now a sizable team of warriors, destroyed the three Imperial signal jammers blocking [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]] from leaving the planet, Solo relayed a mission to the New Republic, alerting them to the Empire's actions on Kashyyyk. However, as there was no way of knowing if they had received the message or not, Chewbacca decided that the only way to end the slavery of his fellow Wookiees was to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|challenge]] Moff Darcc himself. Holed up in his Palace, Darcc's [[Army/Legends|armies]] and his Trandoshan allies prepared for the oncoming invasion. However, the Wookiee force proved even more powerful than Darcc expected, and Chewbacca and his allies pushed through the defenses of the Imperial garrison. Not long after, Darcc's own Palace came under Wookiee siege, and was eventually demolished.<ref name="SWGB" />

===Control terminated===
{{Quote|It looks like your ticket has been punched.|Han Solo, commenting on the deaths of Darcc and Pekt|<ref name="SWGB" />}}
[[File:DarccDeath.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darcc and Pekt lie dead in the ruins of the Avatar Orbital Platform fortress.]]
Darcc escaped the destruction of his Palace through a secret passageway. Meeting with Pekt, Darcc attempted to escape the planet with as many slaves as possible. Weebacca was expected to join the two in the hidden [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]; however he was intercepted and killed by Chewbacca. The delay caused by the fight with Weebacca allowed the Moff and the Trandoshan to escape the planet, their shuttle's cargo hold filled with enslaved Wookiees. Chewbacca, determined to end the threat once and for all, commanded his forces to follow the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was destined for the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Avatar Orbital Platform]], a large shipping center specializing in slave dealings.<ref name="SWGB" />

Darcc and Pekt took refuge within a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on the Avatar platform. There, the two waited and coordinated attacks on Chewbacca's landing party. The timely arrival of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], piloted by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], increased the pressure on Moff Darcc. Eventually, the combined efforts of the airborne aid and the ground-based attacks proved to be too much for the fortress, and both Darcc and Pekt were forced to evacuate the building. However, the Moff and slaver were soon after killed and his remains were obliterated after the destruction of the facility, caused by combined strikes from the Wookiees, Rogue Squadron, and the ''Falcon''.<ref name="SWGB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;a real unsavory character. We're going to need to watch out for him.|Han Solo, commenting on Darcc|<ref name="SWGB" />}}
Darcc was an extremely ambitious man with a desire for power. Given the proper resources, Darcc was able to use situations to rise in rank, gaining favor with his peers, until another opportunity arose where he could further increase his standing.<ref name="DL:TRoDV" /> When given the opportunity, he did not hesitate to proclaim ownership over something, specifically the planet Kashyyyk. With his position of power, Darcc would build extravagant structures for his own use.<ref name="SWGB" />

Darcc also saw the necessity of forming alliances; in order to remove the native Wookiees from the planet, he relied on the Trandoshan Pekt for assistance. Weebacca the Wookiee was also allied with the Imperials during Darcc's reign as Moff, even though the Wookiee species was in fact Darcc's target for elimination from the planet. Still, he considered these alliances disposable, as he made no effort to aid Weebacca when he came under attack; Darcc instead focused on his own escape.<ref name="SWGB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darcc first appeared in the [[2001]] real-time strategy [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', where he served as one of the main antagonists for the Wookiee campaign. Players were often tasked in the later missions to follow a trail leading to an eventual confrontation with the Moff, including bouts through his Imperial garrison and a trip into space, until his final doom on Avatar Orbital Platform.<ref name="SWGB" /> Later, Darcc was given a mention in the [[James Luceno]]-written book ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', as an officer and captain serving under Wilhuff Tarkin, then a Moff. In the book, Darcc welcomes Vader, and escorts the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to Tarkin.<ref name="DL:TRoDV" />

''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' offers a chance for players to participate in the destruction of Avatar Orbital Platform.<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, the timeline for this event contradicts the [[canon]] established by ''Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds'', as Darcc's rise to the title of Moff only occurs after the Battle of Endor and Emperor Palpatine's demise,<ref name="SWGB" /> and ''Galaxies'' occurs before this battle. It is possible that the Avatar Platform the player destroys in ''Galaxies'' was a different platform completely, or a precursor to the Avatar Orbital Platform Moff Darcc controlled; no official explanation has been given.<ref name="Galaxies" />
